reviewer_objection: Only four supported public tasks are evaluated, and two are closely related arithmetic adaptations.
current_evidence: B4 registry and 120-run summary cover four supported tasks; B1 found no eligible new source in the repository.
recommended_action: Keep the pool scope-limited; seek two independent public tasks in B5-Strong and report task-level results.

reviewer_objection: Four public contract/property units are too few for a broad generalization claim.
current_evidence: B4 has 4 public tasks; PUB05 is conditional and PUB06-PUB08 are excluded.
recommended_action: Do not claim ecosystem representativeness; add 2 public tasks if they pass provenance and semantic gates.

reviewer_objection: The controlled contracts may be viewed as hand-built demonstrations rather than realistic workloads.
current_evidence: Formal benchmarks isolate Noisy, Reset, BranchValue, and RepeatedCall obstacles with auditable paths.
recommended_action: Label them controlled/custom/synthetic; add three deeper non-saturated scenarios and mechanism metrics.

reviewer_objection: Original Echidna is the only natural executable comparison, so a broad fuzzer ranking would be under-baselined.
current_evidence: Original, Full-K1, and Full-K5 are in B4; no fair complete SMARTIAN/MuFuzz/IR-Fuzz comparison exists.
recommended_action: Make Original Echidna the main baseline and add lightweight component ablations; do not force a second fuzzer.

reviewer_objection: Ten seeds per B4 cell may be too small for stable probability or statistical claims.
current_evidence: B4 uses seeds 1-10 and is explicitly descriptive.
recommended_action: Avoid inferential or universal claims; only add seeds to 1-2 key cells if B5 reveals instability.

reviewer_objection: Original multi-transaction execution and Harness wrapper execution differ in caller, atomicity, rollback, and context.
current_evidence: Semantic boundary audit and B2 static gate document the differences; all B4 rows remain conditional.
recommended_action: Keep model-specific wording; perform native/caller-controlled replay for any caller-sensitive result or keep it conditional.

reviewer_objection: A caller-sensitive task such as exercise2-access-control may change behavior under a single Harness caller.
current_evidence: PUB05 is conditional_replay_required and excluded from the supported pool.
recommended_action: Do not pool PUB05; if used in an appendix, compare same-caller and alternating-caller schedules.

reviewer_objection: Wrapper-wide rollback can differ from independent transaction rollback and change reachable states.
current_evidence: Semantic audit records wrapper-wide rollback risk; B4 public tasks are screened but not fully equivalent.
recommended_action: Describe the limitation; include atomicity-sensitive cases only with an explicit replay gate.

reviewer_objection: Current wrapper generation does not provide general per-step msg.value/payable semantics.
current_evidence: Semantic audit marks msg.value/payable as a known unsupported general condition; current supported paths avoid it.
recommended_action: Exclude value-sensitive public tasks from pooled results; use a controlled value-gate scenario for lightweight evidence.

reviewer_objection: Observed controlled and public results may not transfer to larger or structurally different contracts.
current_evidence: B4 sources are small; freeze notes explicitly say scale evidence is insufficient.
recommended_action: Narrow the claim and add at least two diverse public tasks or retain a clear external-validity limitation.

reviewer_objection: The current evidence does not present one unified, preregistered component ablation with the same metrics.
current_evidence: Formal summary contains component rows, but historical configurations are not one new factorial B5 package.
recommended_action: Run a lightweight Original/Full/-Repeat/-Value and K1/K5 ablation on controlled/custom scenarios.

reviewer_objection: Falsification rate is nearly saturated and candidate reduction is not an end-to-end performance metric.
current_evidence: B4 has 118/120 falsified and three public task groups at 10/10 for all methods; candidate reduction is static.
recommended_action: Make rank, Top-K hit, target reachability, hard-scenario trigger/time, and stability primary; keep candidate reduction secondary.

reviewer_objection: A reviewer may expect statistical support for a superiority statement from only ten seeds and four tasks.
current_evidence: B4 claim matrix forbids significance and superiority claims; C1 historical statistics do not change B4 scope.
recommended_action: Use descriptive, task-stratified wording; do not claim pooled significance or universal improvement.

reviewer_objection: Nearly every run falsifies, leaving little room for success-rate separation.
current_evidence: B4 reports 118 falsified and 2 budget_exhausted, with both budget observations in echidna-multi.
recommended_action: Use non-saturated custom scenarios and trigger/rank/reachability metrics rather than more seeds on saturated tasks.

reviewer_objection: The apparent success-rate advantage may be an artifact of an easy benchmark ceiling.
current_evidence: B4 flags, multifunc, and onefunc are 10/10 across methods; only multi differs.
recommended_action: Add deeper/noise/value-gated scenarios with fixed hard budgets and report censored time-to-trigger.

reviewer_objection: Original and Harness have different ABI, caller, sequence layer, and transaction semantics, making naive performance comparison unfair.
current_evidence: B3/B4 preregistration explicitly forbids Total calls speedup and full equivalence claims.
recommended_action: Use Original as a scope-matched baseline, do not compare Total calls, and add semantic-compatible controls/replay where needed.

reviewer_objection: Static_gate_pass may be mistaken for a native replay result.
current_evidence: B2 execution_mode is static_gate_only; no row is replay_pass.
recommended_action: Keep static gate wording; perform native replay only for tasks whose results will rely on semantic equivalence or caller behavior.

reviewer_objection: Run records or checksums may be incomplete or may not prove independent reproduction.
current_evidence: B4 has 120/120 complete artifact sets, 120/120 checksum pass, and zero parser/status mismatch.
recommended_action: Show the provenance chain and distinguish auditability from independent replication and safety.

reviewer_objection: A literature list without executable comparisons may look like evasion if the paper claims broad superiority.
current_evidence: SMARTIAN material covers only two simple integer goals; MuFuzz/IR-Fuzz/etc. lack fair runs.
recommended_action: Limit those methods to Related Work; add a second executable baseline only if a low-cost fair alignment exists.

reviewer_objection: The contribution may be perceived as engineering glue if the evaluation does not measure what PHS directly controls.
current_evidence: Method positioning emphasizes property-directed preprocessing, external Harness, and interpretable Top-K.
recommended_action: Make target rank/Top-K/reachability and component ablation central, while avoiding absolute first-use claims.
